title: Zelda Grass
description: This Datapack changes the Loot Table of Short and Tall Grass into that similar to the Zelda Games!
body:
This Datapack changes the Loot Table of Short and Tall Grass into that similar to the Zelda Games! Besides Wheat Seeds, you'll also get a chance of getting:
-Rupees (Can be traded with Villagers and Wandering Villagers; acts like Emeralds, but are retextured to look like a Rupee)
-Heart Container (heals the player 1 Heart)
-Arrows
-TNT (These special TNT can be thrown or placed, and will become a lit TNT that will explode after a few seconds)
